subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Count objects reliably to 40
source.subtopic: Give a reasonable estimate and check by counting out objects reliably; group counting

show.line: Lots of beans! Put them in groups of ten. Ten, twenty, thirty, and four more. Thirty four!

rounds.prompt: Look quickly. About how many bottle tops? Tap your guess.
Now count in groups of ten. How many bottle tops?
rounds.praise: Twenty four! Ten, twenty, and four.

rounds.prompt: Count the sticks in bundles of ten. How many?
Count the shells in groups of five. How many?
Three groups of ten and seven more. How many? Say the number.
Which is the quickest way to count forty buttons?
rounds.praise: Groups of ten are quick to count!

hints: Make groups of ten first. Then count the tens.
Count the leftover ones last and add them on.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Two tens and three ones.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Two tens and three ones. Twenty one!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Twenty, and three more is twenty three.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Ten, twenty, twenty one, twenty two, twenty three!

parent_line: Can estimate and count up to 40 objects in groups of ten and five.
